final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT translink, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM advancedbehavior WHERE translink IS NOT NULL GROUP BY translink), shares AS (SELECT group_count, CAST(group_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(group_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM group_counts), above_average AS (SELECT group_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT AVG(group_count) AS average_group_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM above_average
